dwr_qpe.name: IMD Doppler Weather Radar / radar-derived QPE
dwr_qpe.spatial_resolution: product/request dependent; not verified for Bellandur in this P1 run
dwr_qpe.accessibility: historical access requires registration/request through IMD Radar Data Supply Portal; no anonymous Bellandur historical download was verified
dwr_qpe.suitability: highest-priority future source for nowcasting if access is granted
limitations: not acquired
do not treat the selected IMD GPM product as radar substitute

arg_aws.name: IMD Automatic Weather Station / Automatic Rain Gauge observations
arg_aws.accessibility: official API documentation is public; the AWS mapping endpoint returned HTTP 401 during this run
arg_aws.suitability: potentially useful for point validation, not a gridded surface
limitations: no station record was acquired in P1
station location and temporal continuity must be confirmed before use

imd_dsp.name: IMD DSP historical rainfall file
imd_dsp.accessibility: file adapter configured; source delivery is not assumed
imd_dsp.suitability: historical rainfall ingestion when an official file is supplied
limitations: not a real-time feed
no local source file acquired

mosdac_insat3dr.name: MOSDAC INSAT-3DR 3RIMG_L2B_IMC
mosdac_insat3dr.temporal_resolution: half-hourly files; local set has gaps
mosdac_insat3dr.units: source rain rate mm/hour; normalized rainfall_mm is 30-minute accumulation
mosdac_insat3dr.accessibility: 341 local GeoTIFF files validated and normalized
mosdac_insat3dr.suitability: historical Bellandur rainfall input at native satellite resolution
limitations: satellite-derived QPE, not ground gauge or DWR
native pixels are approximately 4 km and not street-level
temporal coverage contains missing/irregular half-hour intervals

imd_gridded.name: IMD daily gauge-only gridded rainfall
imd_gridded.historical_coverage: archive page advertises 1901 to last year
imd_gridded.suitability: reasonable daily historical baseline; too coarse for street-level nowcasting
limitations: daily temporal resolution
coarse grid relative to Bellandur

imd_ncmrwf_gpm_merged_daily.name: IMD/NCMRWF daily merged satellite-gauge rainfall (GPM-based)
imd_ncmrwf_gpm_merged_daily.provider: India Meteorological Department and National Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasting
imd_ncmrwf_gpm_merged_daily.historical_coverage: official real-time download; historical event availability not assumed
imd_ncmrwf_gpm_merged_daily.format: float32 binary grid plus control file
imd_ncmrwf_gpm_merged_daily.suitability: selected P1 fallback/foundation; covers Bellandur through an intersecting grid cell
limitations: not radar
not street-level
one daily file is a foundation sample, not an event catalogue

imerg.name: NASA GPM IMERG Final / Early / Late
imerg.temporal_resolution: 30 minutes for half-hourly products; daily and other accumulations also available
imerg.historical_coverage: IMERG Final record begins in 1998 per current product documentation
imerg.units: millimetres for accumulation products; rate products may be mm/hr
imerg.format: HDF5, GeoTIFF, NetCDF and other distribution formats
imerg.accessibility: official metadata is public; direct NASA PPS/GES DISC download requires the applicable Earthdata access path/credentials and was not acquired in this run
imerg.suitability: good source-agnostic fallback/supplement for sub-daily historical context, but too coarse for street-level rainfall
limitations: satellite estimate, not radar
coarse relative to this urban study area
Final Run latency is unsuitable for real-time nowcasting

open_meteo_precipitation_forecast.name: Open-Meteo precipitation forecast
open_meteo_precipitation_forecast.spatial_resolution: provider/model grid; returned grid-cell coordinate is preserved
open_meteo_precipitation_forecast.historical_coverage: forecast API; current and forecast periods subject to endpoint limits
open_meteo_precipitation_forecast.accessibility: public no-login endpoint for non-commercial/open access use; no API key configured for this integration
open_meteo_precipitation_forecast.suitability: usable rainfall forcing/forecast supplement for the Bellandur prototype; not radar and not DWR/QPE
limitations: model forecast rather than observation
one deterministic centroid request does not create a street-level field
model grid and forecast values can change as new runs are published
open_meteo_precipitation_forecast.normalization: hourly precipitation to the canonical timestamp, latitude, longitude, rainfall_mm, source schema

rainviewer_radar_observations.name: RainViewer radar observations
rainviewer_radar_observations.spatial_resolution: web-map tile imagery; native radar resolution is provider/source dependent
rainviewer_radar_observations.temporal_resolution: recent/past frames, typically ten-minute intervals over approximately two hours
rainviewer_radar_observations.units: radar imagery/dBZ color encoding; no rainfall-mm values are produced by this adapter
rainviewer_radar_observations.format: JSON timeline metadata and tile URL references
rainviewer_radar_observations.crs: EPSG:4326 target coordinate references; web-map tile imagery
rainviewer_radar_observations.accessibility: public no-login endpoint for personal, educational, and small community use; no API key configured
rainviewer_radar_observations.suitability: radar observation overlay and provenance layer for Bellandur; not a quantitative rainfall input until a validated conversion exists
limitations: future radar nowcast frames were discontinued on 2026-01-01
coverage is not asserted by the timeline endpoint alone
no image-to-mm/h conversion is performed
best-effort service without an SLA
